independent_review.why_this_scope_is_high_risk: FORALL is the richest remaining source of processor latitude in Clause 10. The construct grants substantial freedom about the order in which index values are processed, so the whole value of the registration depends on drawing the line between what is REQUIRED about the final state and what is merely PERMITTED about order. A plan able to detect processing order would not be a conforming test at all.

accounting_verification.detail: The ten numbered units are exactly R1051-R1056 and C1038-C1041 and were already census-accounted; the 18 newly accounted units are the non-numbered paragraphs and notes. No double count and no dropped unit.

required_state_versus_permitted_order.detail: The reviewer derived independently from the source what FORALL requires about the final state - in particular the rules about when each right-hand side is evaluated relative to the assignments, which are the only reason FORALL is testable at all - and confirmed the catalogue neither strengthens nor weakens them. No order-sensitive plan was found anywhere in the packet.

permissions_note: All six were verified correct in both directions - none is a requirement wrongly demoted, and none is latitude wrongly promoted. No plan asserts that the processor took a particular order, counts function calls, relies on a side effect, or observes a temporary.
